# Story 014 frame time, final build: X Damage updates counted for 60 s on one pinned view

Builds: before = ee60523 (the stock terrain shader); after = cadd45d (unity.yml run 40522231518: the snow shader
with the reworked glints, every weight at its default). Each run: the Linux player at 1280x720 on Xvfb with Mesa
llvmpipe (4 CPU cores), the Feel Lab's gravity at 0.001 and 'Apply: restart at top', so every run and build draws
the test slope's start view; --screenshot/--after keep the player drawing in the background. Runs alternate
before, after, before, after. One line per second: <seconds> <updates> <longest gap ms>. A frame is about two
updates (Mesa's HUD read 0.77 frames a second when this counter read 1.4 to 1.5).

```text
before1/frames.txt: 85 frames in 57.7 s, mean 1.47 fps = 678.8 ms a frame, median 1.44 fps, worst gap 1520 ms
before2/frames.txt: 85 frames in 57.9 s, mean 1.47 fps = 681.7 ms a frame, median 1.45 fps, worst gap 1506 ms
after1/frames.txt: 83 frames in 57.3 s, mean 1.45 fps = 690.5 ms a frame, median 1.42 fps, worst gap 1516 ms
after2/frames.txt: 83 frames in 58.2 s, mean 1.43 fps = 700.9 ms a frame, median 1.40 fps, worst gap 1654 ms
```

Mean of the two runs: before 680.3 ms an update, after 695.7 ms: 2.3 percent slower (the AC allows 10).
